Each drawing can be easily moved to another place on the chart, which is sometimes undesirable.</p><p dir="ltr">With this feature, you can make sure they stay exactly where you intend them to be.</p><p dir="ltr">If an accidental drawing replacement happens, you can always press Ctrl + Z or Cmd+Z to undo it — simple.</p><h4 dir="ltr" id="Hide" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span data-darkreader-inline-color="" dir="ltr">Hide options</span></h4><p dir="ltr">Sometimes it's easy to overdo it with drawings and indicators and get lost in all of them. </p><p dir="ltr">To clear up your chart, even temporarily, hide any of these:</p><ul><li data-darkreader-inline-color="" dir="ltr">Drawings</li><li data-darkreader-inline-color="" dir="ltr">Indicators</li><li data-darkreader-inline-color="" dir="ltr">Positions and orders</li><li data-darkreader-inline-color="" dir="ltr">All of them</li></ul><div data-img-border="" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Click to maximize"><img src="https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/43563638517/original/SQ4ANFbmq1YypAGzUTjcz92rstvfexkSUw.gif?1749823132" class="visible-G4cS8IT4"><div class="img-spinner-G4cS8IT4 tv-spinner tv-spinner--shown tv-spinner--size_medium" role="progressbar"></div></div><h4 dir="ltr" id="Sync" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span data-darkreader-inline-color="">Sync drawings options</span></h4><p dir="ltr">With the<a href="https://www.tradingview.com/blog/en/drawings-synchronization-across-layouts-39890/"> Sync drawings options</a>, make them appear on other layouts.
